info.name: Cinema Booking Service
info.description:
API test collection cho du an cinema-booking-service (Giai doan 1). Gom 5 nhom: 'Auth' (dang ky/dang nhap, lay JWT), 'Admin' (CRUD, duoi /api/admin/..., can token ADMIN), 'Public' (chi doc, duoi /api/..., khong can dang nhap), 'Booking' (luong dat ve /api/bookings, can token dang nhap) va 'Payment' (thanh toan gia lap /api/payments + xem ve /api/bookings/{id}/ticket, can token dang nhap).

Cach dung:
1. `docker compose up -d` (Postgres + Redis) roi chay app Spring Boot (`mvn spring-boot:run`).
2. Migration `V3__seed_test_data.sql` tu dong seed san: 2 brand (CGV, BHD), moi brand 1 rap + 1 phong (40 ghe), 6 phim (3 NOW_SHOWING, 2 COMING_SOON, 1 ENDED), 6 the loai, 6 dien vien, 6 suat chieu (hom nay + ngay mai). `V4__seed_demo_users.sql` seed 2 user demo, `V6__add_passwords_to_seed_users.sql` gan mat khau cho 2 user do (`Password123!`) + them 1 user ADMIN demo (`admin@example.com` / `AdminPass123!`).
3. Chay folder 'Auth' truoc tien: 'Login' luu token vao `{{authToken}}` (dung cho Booking/Payment, ke thua o muc collection), 'Login as Admin' luu token vao `{{adminAuthToken}}` (cac folder 'Admin - ...' override auth bang bien nay).
4. Cac request 'List ...' (dau moi folder Admin/Public) tu dong luu id dau tien vao collection variable (VD `{{movieId}}`, `{{cinemaId}}`) qua Tests script - cac request phia sau trong cung folder hoac folder ke tiep dung lai bien do. Nen chay request 'List' truoc khi chay cac request can id.
5. Moi folder Admin CRUD deu tao 1 ban ghi demo rieng (`{{createdXxxId}}`) de test Update/Delete - KHONG dung/xoa du lieu seed, de Public folder luon co du lieu ma khong can chay lai migration.
6. ID thuc te phu thuoc IDENTITY sequence cua Postgres (khong chac chan bat dau tu 1, kieu ca khi rollback/loi migration cung lam tang sequence) - vi vay collection nay khong hardcode id, luon dua vao bien duoc capture o buoc List/Create.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Dang ky/dang nhap (login thuong, JWT). Chay 'Login' va 'Login as Admin' truoc cac folder khac - luu token vao {{authToken}}/{{adminAuthToken}} ma cac folder con lai dung lai (ke thua o muc collection hoac override o muc folder).

item.name: Admin - Genre
item.description: CRUD /api/admin/genres. 'List' luu id dau tien vao {{genreId}} (dung o Admin - Movie). 'Create'->'Get'->'Update'->'Delete' thao tac tren 1 ban ghi demo rieng ({{createdGenreId}}), khong dung ban ghi seed.

item.name: Admin - Actor
item.description: CRUD /api/admin/actors. 'List' luu id dau tien vao {{actorId}} (dung o Admin - Movie).

item.name: Admin - Brand
item.description: CRUD /api/admin/brands. 'List' luu id dau tien vao {{brandId}} (dung o Admin - Cinema va ca Public - Cinema).

item.name: Admin - Cinema
item.description: CRUD /api/admin/cinemas. Create dung {{brandId}} (hang da seed - chay Admin/Public - Brand truoc). 'List' luu id dau tien vao {{cinemaId}}.

item.name: Admin - Room
item.description: CRUD /api/admin/rooms. Create dung {{cinemaId}} (rap da seed). 'List' luu id dau tien vao {{roomId}} (phong da seed - dung o Public - Seat Map giao tiep gian tiep qua showtime, va Admin - Showtime).

item.name: Admin - SeatType
item.description: CRUD /api/admin/seat-types. 'List' luu id dau tien vao {{seatTypeId}} (dung o Admin - Seat layout).

item.name: Admin - Seat (layout)
item.description: Sinh/xem so do ghe theo phong: /api/admin/rooms/{roomId}/seats. Dung {{createdRoomId}} (phong demo tu Admin - Room) chu KHONG dung {{roomId}} (phong seed) - vi request nay GHI DE toan bo ghe cua phong, se pha so do 40 ghe da seed ma Public - Seat Map dang dung de demo.

item.name: Admin - Movie
item.description: CRUD /api/admin/movies. Create dung {{genreId}}/{{actorId}} (the loai/dien vien da seed - chay Admin - Genre va Admin - Actor 'List' truoc). 'List' luu id dau tien vao {{movieId}}.

item.name: Public - Showtime
item.description: /api/cinemas/{cinemaId}/showtimes - man hinh 'Lich chieu cua rap' / 'Chon suat'. Can {{cinemaId}} - chay 'Public - Cinema' truoc. {{today}} tu dong sinh o pre-request script cua collection.

item.name: Showtimes By Cinema, Date And Movie
Public - Seat Map
item.description: /api/showtimes/{id}/seats - man hinh 'Chon ghe'. Can {{showtimeId}} - chay 'Public - Showtime' truoc. Chi co layout + gia tung ghe, chua co trang thai con trong/da dat (se lam khi co seat-hold/lock o Giai doan 2).

item.name: Booking
item.description: Luong dat ve /api/bookings. Can dang nhap (JWT) - userId lay tu token, khong con truyen trong body. Thu tu chay: (1) 'Auth > Login' (de co {{authToken}}) -> (2) 'Public - Brand > List Brands' -> (3) 'Public - Cinema > Cinemas By Brand' -> (4) 'Public - Showtime > Showtimes By Cinema And Date' (de co {{showtimeId}}) -> (5) cac request trong folder nay theo dung thu tu tren xuong. 'Create Booking' + 'Create Booking - Seat Already Booked' dung LAI CUNG {{showtimeId}}/ghe da chon o buoc (2) de minh hoa ca luong thanh cong lan check trung ghe (409); 'Cancel Booking' + 'Cancel Booking - Already Cancelled' minh hoa quy tac chi huy duoc booking dang PENDING.

item.name: Payment
item.description: Thanh toan gia lap /api/payments (bypass, luon SUCCESS) + xem ve /api/bookings/{id}/ticket. Can dang nhap (JWT), ke thua {{authToken}} tu muc collection - chay 'Auth > Login' truoc. Dung RIENG mot booking khac voi folder 'Booking' (ghe thu 3/4 trong so do thay vi ghe thu 1/2) de 2 folder khong tranh ghe khi chay chung 1 collection run. Thu tu chay: (1) 'Auth > Login' -> (2) 'Public - Showtime > Showtimes By Cinema And Date' de co {{showtimeId}} -> (3) cac request trong folder nay theo thu tu tren xuong. 'Pay Booking' tu sinh 1 idempotencyKey moi luu vao {{paymentIdempotencyKey}}; 'Pay Booking - Idempotent Replay' goi lai NGUYEN VEN key do de minh hoa khong bi tinh tien/sinh ve 2 lan; 'Pay Booking - Already Paid (409)' dung idempotencyKey MOI nhung booking da PAID nen van bi tu choi.
